step_by_step_reasoning: The visual diagram and audio transcript describe Zappos' microservice architecture migrated to AWS. User requests are routed by Route 53 to the Front End ALB, which forwards traffic to the Front End ECS container tasks. Front End ECS calls the Back End via Route 53 DNS routing, sending requests to the Back End ALB, which routes to the Back End ECS containers. Back End ECS reads/writes data to Aurora MySQL and sends/receives messages from Amazon MQ. Database Migration Service (DMS) was used to migrate data into Aurora MySQL from an old database.

graph.name: Zappos Back Office Migration Architecture
graph.notes: Architecture uses ECS for containerized services, Route 53 and ALBs for front-end and back-end routing, Aurora MySQL for relational storage, Amazon MQ for messaging, and DMS for migration.

nodes.name: Route 53
nodes.notes: Provides DNS resolution and routing for both front-end and back-end services.

nodes.name: ALB Front End
nodes.notes: Load balances incoming traffic to the front-end container instances.

nodes.name: ECS Front End
nodes.notes: Runs Docker containers for front-end service, configured to auto-scale.

nodes.name: ALB Back End
nodes.notes: Load balances traffic from front-end services to back-end container tasks.

nodes.name: ECS Back End
nodes.notes: Runs back-end business logic in Docker containers on ECS.

nodes.name: Amazon MQ
nodes.notes: Managed message broker replacing legacy ActiveMQ deployment.

nodes.name: Aurora MySQL
nodes.notes: Relational database using custom indexes and read replicas for high performance.

nodes.name: DMS
nodes.notes: Database Migration Service used for initial data transfer and testing during Oracle-to-MySQL migration.

edges.notes: Route 53 routes incoming traffic to Front End ALB.
Front End ALB routes HTTP requests to Front End ECS tasks.
Front End ECS calls Back End service via Route 53 DNS.
Route 53 routes back-end requests to Back End ALB.
Back End ALB forwards requests to Back End ECS tasks.
Back End ECS reads/writes to Aurora MySQL database.
Back End ECS produces and consumes messages with Amazon MQ.
DMS performs data migration dump/sync into Aurora MySQL.
